Notknowing Garden is [FG](about/fg.qmd), a tantra practitioner and facilitator,
and [DS](about/ds.qmd), a yoga teacher and community activist. We lead our
retreats together, combining our two practices. The first two are in 2027.

::: {.ways}
[What you will find here]{.eyebrow}

::: {.way}
[Retreats]{.k}

Two three-day retreats in Germany in 2027, held in English, with accommodation
and food included: [Practitioner Exchange](community/practitioner-exchange.qmd),
for practitioners who want to lead groups, and [Moving
Together](community/moving-together.qmd), a movement retreat for anyone.

[see the retreats →](community/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.way}
[Writing]{.k}

Long reading guides to the research on touch, pain and breathing: what is
known, what is not, and what it means in practice.

[read the writing →](writing/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.way}

Conversations with people who work with the body, hosted by the two of us. No
